articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Investors Ready to Believe the Managed-Care Story Again. Wall Street may be warming back up to the managed-care industry after a rocky 2025. Centene stock saw a 14% surge as its earnings beat analysts’ modest expectations Tuesday morning. Rivals including UnitedHealth Group and Elevance also saw bumps in Tuesday trading. Related tickers mentioned: CNC, CVS, ELV, HUM, UNH.

articles.mainIdea: Does Cigna’s CEO Transition and Dividend Plan Reframe the Bull Case For Cigna Group (CI)?
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Does Cigna’s CEO Transition and Dividend Plan Reframe the Bull Case For Cigna Group (CI)?. The Cigna Group’s recent annual meeting confirmed a quarterly cash dividend of US$1.56 per share, payable on June 18, 2026, and detailed portfolio moves aimed at improving healthcare affordability. The company also announced a leadership change, with long-time CEO David Cordani set to become executive chair as President and COO Brian Evanko assumes the CEO role on July 1, 2026, signaling a new phase in corporate oversight and execution.
